method: GitHub REST issue bodies and all accessible paginated conversation comments; SHA256 covers sorted-key indented UTF-8 issue/comments archive plus newline. Linked external pages and invisible history not fetched.

records.title: [InstCombine] reduce shuffles with constants to a single shuffle
records.scope: Two-source concatenation/constant selection needs a two-source register shuffle and target cost model. Unary dword composition is only a seed, not the reported reduction.

records.title: Some 2-vector vector select identity shuffles may be better represented as moves
records.scope: Partial/identity shuffles becoming partial stores need memory demand and dead-store analysis; a full 16-byte store cannot be silently narrowed.

records.title: Fold smax(shuffle(x,undef,m),shuffle(y,undef,m)) -> shuffle(smax(x,y),undef,m)
records.scope: Original smax/minmax/FMA/funnel intrinsic factoring and poison discussion exceed the integer/bitwise binops admitted here. No FP arithmetic is moved; discarded lanes can affect exceptions.

records.title: Sub-optimal code generation of two successive shuffles
records.scope: Arbitrary 32-byte byte shuffle plus bitcast/dword permutation requires byte provenance and AVX2 lane legalization; flattening masks can worsen target code.

records.title: Shufflevector sequence not optimized to splat in middle-end
records.scope: 2-to-16 byte repeated splat construction changes lengths and merges partial poison lanes; not a four-dword unary chain. Discussion reports an upstream fix, not local coverage.

records.title: [opt] Failure to recognise equivalent shuffled ops
records.scope: Equivalent multiuse splat/binop/extract demands require demanded-element equivalence and dominance-safe reuse, not private syntactic composition.

records.title: Vector bswap should be combined to shufflevector
records.scope: bswap plus reversal needs byte-granularity combination during legalization; converting everything to middle-end shuffles is not universally profitable.

records.title: [X86] Questionable codegen for shuffles + combinations
records.scope: The 8-dword shared-input compare/reduction also requires sign-extension/legalization/reassociation tuning. A private 4-dword 57-then-78 seed is tested, but the actual shared AVX2 network remains deferred.

records.title: High dependency chain of shufflevector instructions
records.scope: Fixed-order recurrence PHIs/history reductions require loop/reduction work (n=2/4/5), not local shuffle composition. Upstream closure is not a local result.

records.title: missed fold, shuffle(shuffle(v1, m1), v2, m2) => shuffle(v1, v2, m3)
records.scope: Two-source nested partial masks need a two-source composition representation and profitability accounting; poison lanes cannot become arbitrary observed data.

records.title: missed fold, failed to kill redundant shufflevector
records.scope: Partial two-source shuffle/fneg needs sign-bit mask semantics and target cost checks. Pure bit permutation is supported, but no FP-negation motion is introduced.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleToIdentity can't handle BITCAST nodes
records.scope: Bitcast-obstructed identity requires byte-level lane tracking across changing element interpretation; this matcher deliberately does not peel casts.

records.title: Non-overlapping shuffle indices could use the same constant
records.scope: AVX2 mask constant sharing and AND/packuswb versus shuffle cost is port- and legalization-dependent; fixed SSE2 immediate composition does not choose this tradeoff.

records.title: [X86] shufflevector codegen regression
records.scope: Byte zero-extension/unpack and word permutations expand during legalization; retaining efficient widening/shuffle forms needs additional backend representation.

records.title: `shufflevector %x, <every odd byte>` should optimize to `lshr %x, @splat(8)`+`trunc`
records.scope: Odd-byte extraction is logical-shift-by-eight plus narrowing 32*u16 to u8; width-changing truncation and AVX512 lowering are outside the fixed-width domain.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfShuffles - failure to merge nested shuffles with common operands
records.scope: Nested four-double two-source masks share operands and need two-source composition; FP add must remain. A 128-bit unary dword rule does not solve this 256-bit example.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldInsExtVectorToShuffle can't handle length changing shuffles
records.scope: Insert/extract of differing vector lengths requires costed narrowing/widening rather than blanket conversion to shuffles.

records.title: [VectorCombine] Handle shuffle of selects
records.scope: Pushing shuffle through select is usually three instructions to four unless inner shuffles simplify; no unconditional select distribution is enabled.

records.title: [X86] Deoptimization of shuffle intrinsics
records.scope: Zero-producing AVX2 PSHUFB/VPERMD masks need explicit zero-byte provenance and target blend/register costs; PSHUFD has no zeroing lanes.

records.title: [SelectionDAG][x86] Shuffle pyramid is not eliminated
records.scope: Reduction-chain vector users need demanded-lane/cycle proof and scalar-to-vector replacement only for unobserved other lanes; SSE4.1 reduction legalization remains separate.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfShuffles - failure to fold shuffle(shuffle(x,y),undef) length changing masks
records.scope: Concat four-to-eight then interleave is length-changing and two-source; the same-length example already folds upstream and is not a new local success.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfCastops - failure to handle unary shuffles to fold shuffle(cast(x), poison) -> cast(shuffle(x,poison))
records.scope: Cast hoisting across unary shuffle requires source-length bounds and poison-versus-undef semantics; no cast peeling or width inference from mask length here.

records.title: [VectorCombine] Failure to merge duplicate new nodes
records.scope: Generated concat shuffles block multiuse FMA merging; a reuse cache must respect dominance/insertion and worklist invalidation. No unsafe global cache is added.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfBinops - support multiple uses of shuffled binops
records.scope: Requested removal of one-use constraints needs retained-cost accounting. This batch deliberately retains private producers, rather than claim shared-case coverage.

records.title: [VectorCombine] Compose nested fixed shuffles through bitcasts
records.scope: ONNX byte-to-word shuffles across bitcasts require byte provenance and per-target gating; reported x86/RVV gains regress AArch64.

records.title: [VectorCombine] foldShuffleOfBinops credits inner shuffles that remain after the fold
records.scope: Calls retain original binops/shuffles, invalidating naive removal credits (real five-to-seven growth). Both shuffled operands must be private in the implemented seed; shared original report remains deferred.

accounting: 26 newly reviewed reports; all original report scopes remain deferred. New private fixed-SSE2 seeds are not whole-report coverage.
